verdict.rationale: Undermind documents its own bulk capabilities. Its MCP tools can resolve titles, DOIs, or an entire bibliography into papers in bulk, and can read full-text PDFs in parallel to answer questions across many papers at once. The enterprise tier adds batch processing for high-volume research work via API. missing for 10: bulk management actions on workspace items (e.g., multi-select folder/star/delete), documented batch API details or limits, independent hands-on corroboration of bulk operations.
